tables.reason: One row per unique SKU with product name plus embedded commercial attributes (currency, sales unit, price list, amount, tax flags), so this is a product-level export whose price fields populate /prices.

columns.name: SKU
columns.reason: Unique 8-character zero-padded product identifier across all 12 rows; header and values match the sku field. Must remain text to preserve leading zeros.

columns.name: Product name
columns.reason: Human-readable product name, unique per SKU and explicitly headed as Product name.

columns.name: Currency
columns.reason: Single explicit currency code PHP on every row; header matches currency and values are ISO-style codes.

columns.name: Sales unit
columns.reason: Single explicit sales unit PCS on every row; header and values match the unit/sell unit field.

columns.name: Price list
columns.reason: Single explicit price-list label standard on every row, corresponding to the required price_list component of each price record.

columns.name: Amount as supplied
columns.reason: Numeric monetary amount unique per row, headed as Amount and matching the price amount field; row-level tax flag determines whether it includes tax.

columns.name: Tax included
columns.reason: Explicit Yes/No row-level flag headed Tax included; directly determines vat_included for each price record.

columns.name: Tax rate
columns.reason: Explicit percentage values 5% and 0% per row, matching a price-level VAT rate; values are row-varying and should be handled as fractions of the supplied percent.

changes_from_draft: /sku: wrapped in cast(to=string) so zero-padded identifiers 00470001..00470012 stay text (profiler typed the column as int); no leading-zero stripping.
/currency: added php→PHP to the map and kept currency exactly as stated in the file (PHP); no FX conversion.
/prices/*/price_list: replaced the hard-coded const 'standard' with the explicit source column 'Price list' (single value 'standard' in 12/12 rows).
/prices/*/vat_included: replaced const true with parse_bool('Tax included') — the flag varies by row (6 Yes, 6 No); the draft's VAT-inclusive assumption was wrong and is removed.
/prices/*/vat_rate: added the missing mapping from 'Tax rate' via parse_number_th(percent_to_fraction=true) → 0.05 / 0.00, replacing the schema default 0.07 with explicit source values.
Record dedupe on /sku; price dedupe keys ['/price_list'] per the schema identity keys.
Quality rules extended: sku not_null/unique, amount not_null/positive, currency ISO-3 regex.
No blocking business questions: currency, unit, price list, amount, VAT inclusion and VAT rate are all explicit per row in the file.
